sources.title: On the dynamics of lattice systems with unbounded on-site terms in the Hamiltonian
sources.reading_depth: Introduction and section 2 through the proof of Lemma 2.2; equations (6)-(12), Proposition 2.1 and Lemma 2.2 checked.
sources.role: Closest checked primary framework for bounded strong operator calculus and integral norm estimates with unbounded onsite terms.
sources.difference: N1 specializes the bounded cocycle argument to the canonical summable profile, complete-factor incidence budget and stationary centered correlations; no new general operator theorem claimed.
